newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize lower in harvest trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize lower in harvest trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was lower in hearty volume trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plentiful harvest supply, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Bahia Blanca lost $2 to $108. Cash soybeans were steady to weaker in moderate volume trade, with crushers holding off buying to let the harvest weigh on prices. FAS elevator soybeans lost $2 in Buenos Aires to $304. Cash sunflower seed was $2 higher in Buenos Aires, at $230. Crushers continue keen to buy to feed oil demand and sunflower volume was good. Cash wheat was steady at $150 in Bahia Blanca in slow end-of-season trade.
